description.value: Krispy Samosa is a family-owned takeout shop serving freshly made samosas crafted from a grandmother's recipe with a variety of fillings including potato and peas, paneer, butter chicken, tandoori chicken, and halal beef. All items are halal-certified and the shop offers vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options. It is a quick, flavourful pit stop for cyclists looking for an affordable and filling snack.
